# Baseline fixture policy

`research-baseline.json` is a source-provenance manifest generated by
`python scripts/capture_baseline.py`. It contains only relative paths, SHA-256
hashes, configuration field/default metadata, notebook structure, and runtime
provenance. It intentionally excludes PDF contents, model files, vectors,
secrets, environment variables, and machine-specific absolute paths.

Regenerate it only when an intentional research-source change has been reviewed
and approved. A changed hash is a baseline drift signal, not a reason to edit
the research source or silently update the manifest.
